name: heat_time_map_fill
description: Fill-in for the cells lost/thin after the 2026-07-30 supply-OCP incident (see data/heat_time_map_20260730_clean.csv). BEFORE RUNNING: raise the bench supply current limit to >= 1.5 A (the OCP at ~1 A killed sweep_132601 entirely and the tail of _135311) AND power-cycle USB + EVM. Cool is raised to 25-30 s for the 300/400 ms rows - at 15 s the baseline ratcheted monotonically above 650 mA. Expect the load cell to clip (490 mN / 5 V) at >=850 mA x 300 ms and >=750 mA x 400 ms: force is lost there but displacement may still be usable while the laser stays in window.
